id: title:HaynesPostHog:revert the follow live mode in the player

review.posthog_relevance: Removes the 'Follow Live' recording playback mode and its associated UI, state, and backend support, including the feature flag, the FollowLive component, and the conditional playback behavior.
review.reason: This chunk removes the REPLAY_FOLLOW_LIVE feature and its implementation, including the feature flag, the FollowLive UI component, the state management, and the associated playback behavior. This is a substantive, bounded removal of a specific capability.
review.uncertainty: The score is assigned based on the removal of a specific feature, but the exact impact on PostHog users and the broader system is not fully understood. The removal of the feature may not have a significant impact on PostHog users, and the removal of the associated playback behavior may not have a significant impact on the system. The score is assigned based on the removal of the RE
